goal: Archived V1 prototype contract tests deterministically locate exactly one immutable archive and fail clearly when evidence is missing or ambiguous.
non_goals: Do not recreate an active build-thesisforge-v1-core change.
Do not mutate archived or active prototype evidence.
Do not add production OpenSpec archive-discovery behavior.
Do not begin PySide6, controller, save, preview, diagnostics, or build work in this slice.
expected_evidence: Observed red baseline from the former active prototype path
Focused zero-match, ambiguous-match, active-exclusion, missing-evidence and immutability tests
Existing harness, artifact and browser-evidence tests passing from the archive
Closest distribution and strict OpenSpec checks
Task report, spec review and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: The former active-change path still exists after archive.
Selecting the newest of multiple matching archives is deterministic enough.
A matching archive directory necessarily contains complete prototype evidence.
Filesystem discovery may touch archived evidence without affecting its evidentiary value.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation would edit outside tests/test_prototype_acceptance.py, mutate prototype evidence, select active changes, or guess among multiple archives.
